summary: Profile of a line checks the shape of each line element on its own. Each section must fit between two lines that follow the true profile. Datums are optional.

cell.zone: At each section, the line of the surface must sit between two lines that follow the true profile. They sit equally either side of it unless the U symbol says otherwise.
cell.datum: Profile of a line can be used with or without datums. Without datums it controls shape only.
cell.mmc: Profile never takes M or L on the tolerance. M or L may appear only on its datum references.
cell.applies: Use it when each line element of a surface matters, but the surface as a whole does not need one zone.
cell.also: With datums, it can also hold the orientation and location of each line.
cell.confused: Shop practice: it is often mixed up with profile of a surface. Profile of a line checks one section at a time. Profile of a surface checks the whole surface at once.
cell.check: Shop practice: scan sections with a CMM, or compare the outline on an optical comparator.
